import argparse
import json
import sys

from tinytasks.api import (
    PastDueDateError, add_tags, archive_task, create_task, delete_task, export_tasks, get_overdue_tasks,
    reschedule_task,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tinytasks")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add")
    p_add.add_argument("title")
    p_add.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    sub.add_parser("overdue")

    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete")
    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)

    p_arch = sub.add_parser("archive")
    p_arch.add_argument("id", type=int)

    p_exp = sub.add_parser("export")
    p_exp.add_argument("--out", help="write to this file instead of stdout")

    p_res = sub.add_parser("reschedule")
    p_res.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_res.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    p_tag = sub.add_parser("tag")
    p_tag.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_tag.add_argument("tags", nargs="+")

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(a.title, a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "archive":
        print("archived" if archive_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "export":
        text = json.dumps(export_tasks(), indent=2)
        if a.out:
            with open(a.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                fh.write(text)
        else:
            print(text)
    elif a.cmd == "reschedule":
        try:
            t = reschedule_task(a.id, a.due_in)
        except PastDueDateError as e:
            print(f"error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        print(f"task {t.id} now due_at={t.due_at}" if t else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "tag":
        t = add_tags(a.id, a.tags)
        print(f"task {t.id} tags: {', '.join(t.tags)}" if t else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import re
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+")


class PastDueDateError(ValueError):
    """Raised when a due date would be in the past."""


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    title = EMAIL_RE.sub("[email]", title)
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Mark a task archived (the record is kept)."""
    tasks = load_all()
    found = False
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            found = True
    save_all(tasks)
    return found


def reschedule_task(task_id: int, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task | None:
    """Move a task's due date to `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    now = time.time()
    if due_in_seconds < 0:
        raise PastDueDateError("due date is in the past")
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.due_at = now + due_in_seconds
            save_all(tasks)
            return t
    return None


def add_tags(task_id: int, tags: list[str]) -> Task | None:
    """Attach tags to a task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            for tag in tags:
                tag = tag.lower()
                if tag not in t.tags:
                    t.tags.append(tag)
            save_all(tasks)
            return t
    return None


def export_tasks() -> list[dict]:
    """Active (non-archived) tasks as plain dicts, for handing to other systems."""
    return [dict(t.__dict__) for t in load_all() if not t.archived]

import sys
import time

import pytest

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import (
    PastDueDateError, add_tags, archive_task, create_task, delete_task, export_tasks, get_overdue_tasks, reschedule_task,
)
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def test_create_task_sets_due_at_seconds_from_now(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    before = time.time()
    t = create_task("write report", due_in_seconds=3600)
    assert 3500 < t.due_at - before < 3700


def test_overdue_tasks_filters_by_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("already late", due_in_seconds=-10)
    create_task("not yet", due_in_seconds=10000)
    overdue = get_overdue_tasks()
    assert [t.title for t in overdue] == ["already late"]


def test_delete_task_removes_it(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("temp", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert delete_task(t.id) is True
    assert load_all() == []


def test_archive_task_keeps_the_record(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert archive_task(t.id) is True
    assert load_all()[0].archived is True


def test_reschedule_task_moves_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("move me", due_in_seconds=60)
    before = time.time()
    moved = reschedule_task(t.id, 7200)
    assert 7100 < moved.due_at - before < 7300


def test_add_tags_attaches_tags(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("tagged", due_in_seconds=60)
    add_tags(t.id, ["work", "home"])
    assert load_all()[0].tags == ["work", "home"]


def test_export_excludes_archived_tasks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C1, P2
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("active", due_in_seconds=60)
    old = create_task("archived", due_in_seconds=60)
    archive_task(old.id)
    assert [d["title"] for d in export_tasks()] == ["active"]


def test_export_cli_excludes_archived_tasks(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):  # C1, P2
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("active", due_in_seconds=60)
    old = create_task("old-task", due_in_seconds=60)
    archive_task(old.id)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "export"])
    cli.main()
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "active" in out and "old-task" not in out


def test_add_redacts_email_in_title(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C2
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("call bob.smith+x@example.co.uk about a@b.com", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert t.title == "call [email] about [email]"
    assert load_all()[0].title == "call [email] about [email]"


def test_reschedule_rejects_past_due_date(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C3
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("keep me", due_in_seconds=60)
    original = load_all()[0].due_at
    with pytest.raises(PastDueDateError):
        reschedule_task(t.id, -10)
    assert load_all()[0].due_at == original


def test_reschedule_cli_past_due_exits_nonzero(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C3
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("keep me", due_in_seconds=60)
    original = load_all()[0].due_at
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "reschedule", str(t.id), "--due-in", "-10"])

import sys
import time

import pytest

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import (
    PastDueDateError, add_tags, archive_task, create_task, delete_task, export_tasks, get_overdue_tasks, reschedule_task,
)
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def test_create_task_sets_due_at_seconds_from_now(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    before = time.time()
    t = create_task("write report", due_in_seconds=3600)
    assert 3500 < t.due_at - before < 3700


def test_overdue_tasks_filters_by_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("already late", due_in_seconds=-10)
    create_task("not yet", due_in_seconds=10000)
    overdue = get_overdue_tasks()
    assert [t.title for t in overdue] == ["already late"]


def test_delete_task_removes_it(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("temp", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert delete_task(t.id) is True
    assert load_all() == []


def test_archive_task_keeps_the_record(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert archive_task(t.id) is True
    assert load_all()[0].archived is True


def test_reschedule_task_moves_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("move me", due_in_seconds=60)
    before = time.time()
    moved = reschedule_task(t.id, 7200)
    assert 7100 < moved.due_at - before < 7300


def test_add_tags_attaches_tags(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("tagged", due_in_seconds=60)
    add_tags(t.id, ["work", "home"])
    assert load_all()[0].tags == ["work", "home"]

    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("active", due_in_seconds=60)

    archive_task(old.id)

# TinyTasks conventions

Rules below came from forwarded documents (Dana Whitfield, Ops). Keep each tied to its source.

## From: Northwind Compliance Office memo, DRAFT v0.3 (still a draft; re-check if a final version differs)

- C1: Archived tasks must never leave our systems; `export` omits archived tasks.
- C2: No email addresses in task titles; `add` replaces any email in the title with the literal `[email]` before storing.
- C3: No back-dated deadlines; `reschedule` rejects a due date in the past (non-zero exit, task unchanged).

## From: Product Spec v2 (owner: Priya Raman, Product)

- P1: Tags are case-insensitive; `tag` stores every tag lowercase.
- P2: `export` outputs active tasks only (nothing archived). Same behavior as C1.

"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import re
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+")


class PastDueDateError(ValueError):
    """Raised when a due date would be in the past."""


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Mark a task archived (the record is kept)."""
    tasks = load_all()
    found = False
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            found = True
    save_all(tasks)
    return found


def reschedule_task(task_id: int, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task | None:
    """Move a task's due date to `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    now = time.time()
    if due_in_seconds < 0:
        raise PastDueDateError("due date is in the past")
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.due_at = now + due_in_seconds
            save_all(tasks)
            return t
    return None


def add_tags(task_id: int, tags: list[str]) -> Task | None:
    """Attach tags to a task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            for tag in tags:
                tag = tag.lower()
                if tag not in t.tags:
                    t.tags.append(tag)
            save_all(tasks)
            return t
    return None


def export_tasks() -> list[dict]:
    """Active (non-archived) tasks as plain dicts, for handing to other systems."""
    return [dict(t.__dict__) for t in load_all() if not t.archived]
